'''Baous Gapuois''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] in [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. He was present during the [[Rakghoul pandemic]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], stationed in the operations command center within the [[rakghoul tunnels]] and was specializing as a [[Quartermaster/Legends|supply officer]] for THORN volunteers affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He would later be stationed in the rakghoul tunnels on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
